commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/atomic-release-publication
tmp_script="$base/bin/.publish.new.$$"
trap 'rm -f -- "$tmp_script"' 0 1 2 3 15
cat > "$tmp_script" <<'PUBLISH_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

case $1 in
    /*) candidate=$1 ;;
    *)  candidate=$base/$1 ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$candidate" ]; then
    printf 'publish: release directory does not exist: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

release=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$candidate" && pwd -P)
if [ ! -f "$release/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf 'publish: refusing incomplete release (MANIFEST missing): %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Build the replacement beside current, then rename it over current.  rename(2)
# makes the switch indivisible: readers resolve either the old or new symlink.
tmp=$base/.current.$$
cleanup() {
    rm -f -- "$tmp"
}
trap cleanup 0
trap 'exit 1' 1 2 3 15

ln -s -- "$release" "$tmp"
mv -Tf -- "$tmp" "$base/current"
PUBLISH_EOF
chmod 755 "$tmp_script"
chown --reference="$base/bin/publish" "$tmp_script"
mv -f -- "$tmp_script" "$base/bin/publish"
trap - 0 1 2 3 15
printf '%s\n' 'installed publisher:'
sed -n '1,240p' "$base/bin/publish"
printf 'mode_owner='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$base/bin/publish"
commands.stdout:
installed publisher:

commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/atomic-release-publication
flag=/tmp/atomic-publish-writer.running
reader_result=/tmp/atomic-publish-reader.result
reader_fail=/tmp/atomic-publish-reader.fail
rm -f "$reader_result" "$reader_fail"
: > "$flag"
(
    i=0
    while [ -e "$flag" ] || [ "$i" -lt 1000 ]; do
        target=$(readlink "$base/current") || {
            printf 'current missing at iteration %s\n' "$i" > "$reader_fail"
            exit 1
        }
        [ -d "$target" ] || {
            printf 'target not a directory at iteration %s: %s\n' "$i" "$target" > "$reader_fail"
            exit 1
        }
        manifest=$(cat "$target/MANIFEST") || {
            printf 'MANIFEST unreadable at iteration %s: %s\n' "$i" "$target" > "$reader_fail"
            exit 1
        }
        index=$(cat "$target/index.txt") || {
            printf 'index unreadable at iteration %s: %s\n' "$i" "$target" > "$reader_fail"
            exit 1
        }
        case "$manifest|$index" in
            'release=one|Complete release one.'|'release=two|Complete release two.') ;;
            *) printf 'mixed or incomplete release at iteration %s: %s|%s\n' "$i" "$manifest" "$index" > "$reader_fail"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$i" > "$reader_result"
) &
reader_pid=$!
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 300 ]; do
    "$base/bin/publish" releases/two
    "$base/bin/publish" releases/one
    i=$((i + 1))
done
rm -f "$flag"
wait "$reader_pid"
[ ! -e "$reader_fail" ] || { cat "$reader_fail"; exit 1; }
printf 'atomic_reader_checks='; cat "$reader_result"
printf 'final_target='; readlink "$base/current"
printf 'final_manifest='; cat "$base/current/MANIFEST"
printf 'final_index='; cat "$base/current/index.txt"
printf 'staged_release_dirs='; find "$base/releases" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f ' | sort; printf '\n'
printf '%s\n' 'RESULT=600 concurrent swaps exposed no missing, mixed, or incomplete release; rollback to release one succeeded'

final_manifest=release=one
